_source: Old BOM REVISI BOM 21 MEI 26, rows 93-115 (export lines 7520-7540). Expected new estimate: docs/SPEC-costing-system.md C4.3 row AA-04B. Rulings applied from C4.5: #2 sizes entered longest side first, every component EXPOSED = Y, and CURVED = Y on the lamp housings and corner blocks of the vanity mirrors; #4 the old BOM gives this panel a size, so it is nested rather than entered as manual sheets; #5 glass, LED parts and hanging hardware stay at old-BOM prices on the bought-in lines; #6 an assembled item takes the template default carton, overall size + 40 mm, which replaces the old purchased box and packing lines. The old panel row reads 'PLYWOOD 12 MM PALM' but carries 9 in its HEIGHT column; the new estimate prices it as 12 mm (PLY-12-RAW, 215,000 per sheet), so t is 12 here. The plywood sits behind the mirror and takes no finish, hence exposed_faces 0. LABOR PRODUCTION, FINISHING NATURAL, BOX and PACKING of the old BOM are dropped because carpentry labour, the four finishing lines and the carton rule now derive them.
